turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to reproduce that self-distillation paper's results on my local rig. Do you have the config for the 'Apex Agents' workload?
I don't have a specific config file named 'Apex Agents' in your recent context. Could you share the parameters or the paper you're referencing?
Right, sorry. I set it up last month. It was scaled to 8B parameters with about 50 tool calls. That's the baseline I want to match first.
Got it. 8B parameters and 50 tool calls. I'll note that as the baseline configuration for the Apex Agents workload.
Thanks. Also, did you see the rain forecast for tomorrow? I might need to bring my umbrella.
Yes, there is a 70% chance of rain tomorrow afternoon. Bringing an umbrella is a good idea.
Lloyd, I need to update my training scripts. The Apex Agents workload definition has changed since last month.
Sure, what are the new parameters for the Apex Agents workload?
The fixed On-Policy Self-Distillation recipe was scaled up. It's now 12B parameters with 100+ tool calls. Please update my notes to reflect this current state.
Updated. I've recorded the Apex Agents workload as using 12B parameters and 100+ tool calls for the On-Policy Self-Distillation recipe.
Great. By the way, that new graphics card I ordered arrived today. It's huge.
That's exciting! Hope it fits in your case. Did you manage to install it smoothly?
Mostly, just needed to move some cables. Anyway, back to the workload, make sure I don't use the old numbers again.
Understood. I will use the new 12B/100+ configuration for any future queries regarding Apex Agents.
